review_scope: Every current Gauteng queue identity whose factual identity is supported but whose parent is not yet an accepted runtime market.
decision_policy: A locality is promoted only with an identity-specific, cited parent assertion to an existing accepted runtime market.
Municipality context, proximity, postal text, facility names, and broad regional labels do not establish a town parent by themselves.
Conflicting same-name or boundary evidence remains queued until the authority is reconciled; the pipeline does not choose a precedence.
This audit records retain-queue decisions only; it does not create runtime rows or alter canonical identities.

evidence_reviewed.finding: Municipal overview identifies the municipality and its principal mining towns, but does not make an Eastdene-to-town parent assertion.
Current IDP material was reviewed for an identity-specific Eastdene parent; no accepted town edge was found.

entries.rationale: The canonical identity is supported as a West Rand suburb, but the reviewed official material does not connect Eastdene to an existing accepted runtime town. A nearby-place relation from non-authoritative mapping would not satisfy the parent rule.
entries.next_action: Re-review against an official municipal, cadastral, planning, or gazette record that explicitly places Eastdene under an accepted Merafong town.
